mapping_rationale: All three frameworks require documented and governed cybersecurity or information security policy.
nist_control_title: Cybersecurity risk management policy is established communicated and enforced
required_evidence: Approved cybersecurity policy with owner approval and documented review date

mapping_rationale: Each framework requires vulnerabilities to be identified and managed through an established process.
nist_control_title: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified validated and recorded
required_evidence: Vulnerability scan reports remediation tickets and remediation tracking records

mapping_rationale: The controls align around continuous security monitoring, event detection, and operational visibility.
nist_control_title: Networks and network services are monitored
required_evidence: SIEM logs monitoring dashboards alert records and monitoring procedures

mapping_rationale: All three frameworks require formal preparation and execution of incident-management activities.
iso_control_title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
nist_control_title: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant parties
required_evidence: Incident response plan incident tickets investigation records and post-incident reports

mapping_rationale: Controls establish identity, authorization, and access governance expectations.
nist_control_title: Identities and credentials are managed for authorized users services and hardware
required_evidence: Access review records user provisioning records role assignments and approval evidence

mapping_rationale: ISO and NIST have explicit configuration-management references in this catalog extract, while no directly mapped SAMA control was selected.
nist_control_title: Configuration management practices are established and applied
required_evidence: Approved configuration baseline change records and configuration review evidence

mapping_rationale: Logging and monitoring requirements support detection and security-event management across the frameworks.
nist_control_title: Networks and network services are monitored
required_evidence: Audit logs log-retention configuration and centralized logging evidence

mapping_rationale: A recovery-specific NIST outcome is present in the sample catalog, but equivalent ISO and SAMA controls were not included in this simplified extract.
nist_control_title: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed
required_evidence: Recovery plan backup records recovery test results and restoration evidence
